# RPG MPC solver

Source is [uzh-rpg/rpg_mpc at 33263db](https://github.com/uzh-rpg/rpg_mpc/tree/33263db209105f716e204acc6481834fbd9bc778).
The generated ACADO solver, model source and bundled qpOASES sources are preserved from upstream.
The project uses the upstream solver in its ROS 2 controller through a local adapter.

See [RPG MPC COPYING](COPYING), the generated file notices and
[qpOASES LICENSE.txt](externals/qpoases/LICENSE.txt) for the bundled code's terms.
